node.title: E1 two-cell folded manifest assembly soundness
node.statement: If the N'=128 and N'=256 E1 cell payloads each supply a named complete folded certificate with zero nonzero non-cyclotomic folded vectors, then e1_folded_certificate_manifest_payload holds.
node.attack_surface: finite manifest coverage and schema assembly for the two E1 open cells
node.falsifier: both cell certificates are complete and zero but the two-cell E1 manifest is invalid
